record.question: Recently, the QUAD nations launched the 'At Sea Observer Mission' to boost maritime cooperation. Which of the following are members of QUAD?
record.explanation: Answer B: Australia, India, Japan and US. The Quad consists of Australia, India, Japan and the United States. Reference: https://www.mea.gov.in/Portal/ForeignRelation/Quad-July-2024.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: LDC Law & Judicial Paper-I, February 2026 examination; current officeholder/current affairs claims interpreted as of paper date.. Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
